title: Unrealistic Goals
description: Fitness client has unrealistic expectations about results
initialPrompt: Хочу накачаться как Шварценеггер за месяц! И похудеть на 20 кг. Возможно?
systemPrompt: You are a fitness trainer. Client has unrealistic goals - wants bodybuilder physique in a month. Redirect to realistic expectations kindly. Suggest 3-6 month timeline. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User set realistic goals with proper timeline.
hints: Давайте поставим достижимые цели (Let's set achievable goals)
За три месяца можно... (In three months you can...)
